matchups.tips: | Tips: W his Passive-AA. Dodge inwards when he Q's. Early Bramble Vest can be good. Either insta E or don't E at all if he hits W, if you wait and E at the wrong time, you will get pulled back and die. He can also interrupt your E with his Qs.
| Tips: W her Passive-AA (easy if you always W when she recasts E). Taunt reveals her from Shroud. Flash her R2. Passive shield her Q-poke.
| Tips: Use W to deny his passive stacks. Remember that his dash will get cancelled if he collides with a champion. His R gets blocked by minions and towers.
| Tips: W blocks her Q1 and Q2. Use W insta when she E2's from Wall. Either Passive shield her W or E in. Her E has higher priority than your E (yours will get interrupted).
| Tips: Don't E In unless she wasted abilities. Passive shield her E's. Always try to dodge her Q. Turn around when Taunt durations ends to dodge her R if she's spamming it. Her W stops your R.
| Tips: W block his E-AA reset. Dodge his Q by E'ing in. Remember that he restores HP and Mana from killing minions. If he wastes W or Q, you can punish.
| Tips: NEVER E in if he has E up. Take short trades and don't give him 5 stacks of passive. Predict his Q-(Stridebreaker)-Flash when you're low HP and E/Flash towards him to dodge Q sweet spot.
| Tips: W his E-AA reset. Dodge Q's by hiding behind minions. Bramble Vest can be good.

| Tips: Your W blocks vital hits and her Q. Stand against wall if you want to fight her Ult. Bramble Vest is good. Dodge her W at all costs, the AS slow is too strong. Your E vs her W is mostly mind game, you can hold it and wait for her to use W first.

| Tips: Passive shield his Q and E poke. W every Q you can (prevents Grasp). When you E in, always kill his barrel on first AA and then focus him. Even if he W's perfectly your auto will hit barrel first.
| Tips: W his Q. E backwards through him when E's. Stop his passive if possible.
| Tips: Passive shield his Q and AA poke. W to stop his W 3rd stack. Stand away from walls to prevent R stun. Don't engage when he's about to transform.
| Tips: Block his W with your W. His E stops your E so be patient and use at close range or after he uses it. Passive shield Q poke.
| Tips: She is surprisingly tanky and wins extended fights. Short trades and W when she E's in to trade. Your W does NOT block her Q.
| Tips: W his E-AA damage. Try to fight him when he has no Q stacks. Force him away from wave to prevent Q stacking. You win with short trades.
| Tips: W blocks his Turret AAs. Use Passive shield when going in to kill Turrets. Engage only if he wastes E.

| Tips: W her W-AA. Learn to dodge her E or dodge the game. If you get hit by E, instantly run away from spirit range. Dodge tentacles by moving straight at a 90 degree angle. When she R's, just disengage.
| Tips: Predict her Q jump on low health minions with your E. Dodge her E. Your W blocks her Q and Passive on-hit. Don't walk through her R-blades if possible.
| Tips: Your W blocks his W and Passive R. Fight him with Q and when he E's, wait 0.75 sec and then E backwards through him to prevent stun completely. Repeat this and win the lane.

| Tips: Your W blocks his R-enhanced AA and his CannonW-AAs. Passive shield his Q and AA poke. Engage when he transform from Hammer to Cannon, because then he doesn't have access to Knockback-E during the trade.
| Tips: Don't fight her unless you get a gank. Passive shield and W her Q and AA poke to stay healthy while farming. Only engage if she wastes W somehow.
| Tips: Punish her early. She outscales you hard. W blocks her E-AA. Passive shield or dodge her Q, remember that she can hit Q through minions. Taunt prevents her from R'ing.

| Tips: W blocks his Passive W-AA. Dodge or Passive shield his Q poke. You can E him when he E's and he can't do anything except follow your champion (no AAs in Lightning form). This can be used to pull him under Tower.

| Tips: W blocks his W-AAs and also prevents him from gaining Courage while unmounted. 99% of Kled players are not aware of this and you can bait them into situations where they are used to re-mounting and then kill then. Dodge his Mounted Q. Mounted Q2 interrupts your E.
| Tips: You should beat him in the early game. Dodge his Qs by staying behind minions and trade after he uses E to waveclear.
| Tips: Don't E in unless he uses E. Play passively and farm while staying healthy with Passive shield and W. He wants to punish you.
| Tips: Passive shield his Q poke. W his W-AA reset. Flashing his R is really easy if you are prepared for it. Punish him if he uses E on wave. The AS Slow from his E is really powerful.
| Tips: Passive shield his Q poke. Don't run into bushes with saplings. Don't try to dive him because he can CC you for 3 seconds.
| Tips: Don't All-in unless you know you can kill him. Passive shield his Qs. Never get hit by isolated Q. Dodge his E by E'ing in (if possible).
| Tips: Your W blocks his Q. Passive shield his E poke. Disengage when he R's.
| Tips: Don't E in. Dodge or passive shield her Q and E poke. W her Empowered W-AA. E backwards through her when she ults. This is literally the worst matchup for Shen.
| Tips: QSS his R near-sight if you want to ult. Take short trades. Try to maximize the amount of AAs blocked by your W. Passive shield his Q.
| Tips: He beats basically every all-in, so basically you should never E in. Passive shield his Q poke. Use W when he W's.
| Tips: Passive shield his Q poke. Always block his Brittle AA with your W. E him to prevent his R2. Don't let your E get interrupted by his E or R.
| Tips: Passive shield his Q poke. Insta W when he W's. Remember that E gives him invulnerability from one-side only.
| Tips: W her Passive AA's (prevents Grasp). Passive shield her Q1 if possible. Never get hit by her Q2. Don't let her E you into a wall.
| Tips: Passive shield when you go to last hit a minion. Your W blocks her Passive mark AA. She gets taunted if she E's your E.
| Tips: Don't give him free Q heals. It's a skill-based matchup because of your W. If you can block his Ws then you win. If not, you lose. Disengage when he R's.

| Tips: Your W blocks his Q-AAs and his R-AA. Try to block his R-AA because it reduces your (or your allies) armor if you don't W it. Don't E him when he has full ferocity, he can just Empowered W to cleanse it and heal the damage.
| TIps: Insta W when she goes for a longer trade. Your W blocks her Passive-AAs. Don't E into her Q3, it will get interrupted. Flash her R2 if possible.
| Tips: W is best used if he overheats, because it blocks his empowered AAs. Passive shield his Q and E poke whenever possible. Immediately E away from his R.
| Tips: Passive shield his poke (not much to say here). You can E in if he wastes W. Your E stops his R.
| Tips: Use Q-W when he E's you. Dodge his W sweet spot at all costs. He can W-Flash at last second to redirect the cone. Very difficult matchup, but winnable if you are the better player.
| Tips: Don't get Flinged into his W. His W stops your R and prevents your E. Don't chase him. Early wave clear items to match his shove.

| Tips: If you E cancel his Q, he will get it back on a very short cooldown, but it's still the right decision in a lot of scenarios. Passive shield his Q and E poke. Save your W for after he dies, you can block his AAs (prevents him from life stealing) and save allies.
| Tips: Play aggressively. Always inform your team (by spam pinging) when he clones your R. Ignite early to prevent his W heals. Don't get hit by Q2.
| Tips: He's very strong in extended 1v1s. You can prevent his Passive stacks by blocking AAs with W. Work on dodging his Qs and/or passive shield them.
| Tips: Passive shield his Qs and W his AAs. Play patiently and look for gank opportunities.
| Tips: He's weak without Fury, so zone him from the wave when ahead. If you leash and he gets to stack up Fury, don't even walk up. Timing your W well is the deciding factor in this matchup.
| Tips: Your W blocks his W. Passive shield or dodge his Qs. Don't walk up level 1, because he can kill you with E start. If he wastes Q or W, you can punish with a trade. Flash his R if possible.
| Tips: Prevent her from hitting 3 W-stacks on you by blocking AAs with your W. Play patiently. If she wastes E you punish with a trade (if you have the HP for it).

| Tips: His W has a massive cooldown in the early game, use it to your advantage. Passive shield his Q's. Your W does not do much in this matchup, you can use it freely to block even just 1 AA. Keep in mind that it will provide more value in a gank situation. A good Vladimir is very annoying to play against.

| Tips: Your W does NOT stop him from applying debuff with his first W. It does stop the empowered damage from his second W. Your W also blocks his Q stun. This is very important, because it allows you to dodge his E. If you get stunned and hit by his E, you lose the lane.

| Tips: W his Q's. Be patient with your E. If E at close range, it's very hard to dodge, even with his W. If you E at max range, he can easily dodge it with W. His all-in is very strong after 6. You can use W after he E's in because it will more efficient due to his high AS.

| Tips: Your W blocks his Q if you are the first target it hits. He can windwall your Q pull and deny you from getting the Q stacks. Only very experienced Yasuo players know this, but if they do it correctly, it will cripple you severely. You will lose the energy in casting Q and have no way of getting it back.
| Tips: Your W blocks his Q if you are the first target it hits. His E acts as a cleanse from your taunt if it's timing out.
| Tips: Your W blocks his Q and Ghoul AAs. Try to dodge his E at all costs. If he hits E, don't walk up. This is very important. If he misses E, punish him with a trade.

| Tips: Your W technically blocks his Q2, but he can prevent this by hitting Q1 on you can Q2 on a minion, instead of the other way around. Try to step on his Passive blobs to prevent him from healing. His knock-ups interrupt your E.
